server:
  port: 8080
  servlet:
    context-path: /api

spring:
  application:
    name: craft-market-booth
  
  # 数据库配置
  datasource:
    driver-class-name: com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
    url: jdbc:mysql://${DB_HOST:localhost}:${DB_PORT:3306}/craft_market_booth?useUnicode=true&characterEncoding=utf-8&useSSL=false&serverTimezone=Asia/Shanghai
    username: ${DB_USERNAME:root}
    password: ${DB_PASSWORD:root}
  
  # Jackson配置
  jackson:
    date-format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
    time-zone: GMT+8
  
  # 文件上传配置
  servlet:
    multipart:
      max-file-size: 10MB
      max-request-size: 10MB
  
  # 模板引擎配置（虽然不需要前端，但保留以备不时之需）
  thymeleaf:
    cache: false
    encoding: UTF-8
    mode: HTML

# MyBatis Plus配置
mybatis-plus:
  configuration:
    map-underscore-to-camel-case: true
    cache-enabled: false
    call-setters-on-nulls: true
    jdbc-type-for-null: null
  global-config:
    db-config:
      id-type: auto
      logic-delete-field: deleted
      logic-delete-value: 1
      logic-not-delete-value: 0
  mapper-locations: classpath:mapper/*.xml

# JWT配置
jwt:
  secret: ${JWT_SECRET:craft_market_booth_secret_key_2024}
  expiration: 86400000 # 24小时

# 日志配置
logging:
  level:
    com.craftmarket: debug
    org.springframework.security: debug
  pattern:
    console: "%d{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} [%thread] %-5level %logger{36} - %msg%n"
    file: "%d{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} [%thread] %-5level %logger{36} - %msg%n"
  file:
    name: logs/craft-market-booth.log
    max-size: 10MB
    max-history: 30

# 业务配置
business:
  # 分页配置
  page:
    default-size: 10
    max-size: 100
  
  # 文件上传配置
  upload:
    path: ${UPLOAD_PATH:./uploads}
    allowed-types: image/jpeg,image/png,image/gif,image/webp

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.craftmarket.mapper.MarketEventMapper">

    <!-- 根据状态查询活动列表 -->
    <select id="selectEventsByStatus" resultType="com.craftmarket.entity.MarketEvent">
        SELECT * FROM market_event
        WHERE status = #{status} AND deleted = 0
        ORDER BY event_start_time DESC
    </select>

    <!-- 查询活动中可用摊位（按区域） -->
    <select id="selectAvailableBoothsByEvent" resultType="com.craftmarket.entity.MarketEvent">
        SELECT 
            me.*,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booth b 
             WHERE b.event_id = me.id 
             AND b.area = #{area}
             AND b.status = 'AVAILABLE' 
             AND b.deleted = 0) AS available_booths_count
        FROM market_event me
        WHERE me.id = #{eventId} AND me.deleted = 0
    </select>

</mapper>
